wellness_summary.intro: Based on Dolly's breed, age, body size and biological characteristics, our veterinary research team estimates that preventative activity support, joint support and skin health care will provide the greatest long-term health benefit.
wellness_summary.closing: We created several personalized wellness plans that balance health coverage and monthly cost.

analysis_detail.title: Activity Support
analysis_detail.explanation: Our veterinary research team estimates Dolly may benefit from preventative activity support support — structured activity and recovery nutrition may support high-drive working and sporting biology. This does NOT mean Dolly will develop illness; it highlights areas where long-term wellness care may help most.

analysis_detail.title: Joint Support
analysis_detail.explanation: Our veterinary research team estimates Dolly may benefit from preventative joint health support — elevated lifetime joint-support needs based on body conformation, size, and published veterinary prevalence studies. This does NOT mean Dolly will develop illness; it highlights areas where long-term wellness care may help most.

analysis_detail.title: Skin Health
analysis_detail.explanation: Our veterinary research team estimates Dolly may benefit from preventative skin health support — additional skin-barrier and coat support may provide long-term comfort based on coat biology and dermatology evidence. This does NOT mean Dolly will develop illness; it highlights areas where long-term wellness care may help most.

analysis_detail.title: General Wellness
analysis_detail.explanation: Our veterinary research team estimates Dolly may benefit from preventative general wellness support — preventative care may provide long-term benefit. This does NOT mean Dolly will develop illness; it highlights areas where long-term wellness care may help most.

analysis_detail.title: Dental Care
analysis_detail.explanation: Our veterinary research team estimates Dolly may benefit from preventative dental health support — preventative oral care may reduce plaque burden common in companion breeds with compact dentition. This does NOT mean Dolly will develop illness; it highlights areas where long-term wellness care may help most.

analysis_detail.title: Healthy Weight
analysis_detail.explanation: Our veterinary research team estimates Dolly may benefit from preventative weight management support — metabolic and activity biology suggests proactive weight management may improve long-term mobility. This does NOT mean Dolly will develop illness; it highlights areas where long-term wellness care may help most.

preventativeNutritionSystem.narrative_synthesis: Dolly inherited a Double Coat from their Golden Retriever ancestry. While advantageous for environmental adaptation and physiological resilience, in a Shanghai Summer environment, this trait presents specific management considerations, such as a 53.1% incidence of Cruciate Ligament Rupture observed in breed-specific observational cohorts (Source: Veterinary comparative epidemiology dataset). To proactively manage this, lifestyle modifications including Hydrotherapy treadmill are recommended. Furthermore, based on veterinary physiology, targeted nutritional intervention with Glucosamine is required at a dosage of 500 to support long-term health.

risks.why: Our veterinary research team estimates Dolly may benefit from preventative activity support support — structured activity and recovery nutrition may support high-drive working and sporting biology. This does NOT mean Dolly will develop illness; it highlights areas where long-term wellness care may help most.

Our veterinary research team estimates Dolly may benefit from preventative joint health support — elevated lifetime joint-support needs based on body conformation, size, and published veterinary prevalence studies. This does NOT mean Dolly will develop illness; it highlights areas where long-term wellness care may help most.

Our veterinary research team estimates Dolly may benefit from preventative skin health support — additional skin-barrier and coat support may provide long-term comfort based on coat biology and dermatology evidence. This does NOT mean Dolly will develop illness; it highlights areas where long-term wellness care may help most.

Our veterinary research team estimates Dolly may benefit from preventative general wellness support — preventative care may provide long-term benefit. This does NOT mean Dolly will develop illness; it highlights areas where long-term wellness care may help most.

Our veterinary research team estimates Dolly may benefit from preventative dental health support — preventative oral care may reduce plaque burden common in companion breeds with compact dentition. This does NOT mean Dolly will develop illness; it highlights areas where long-term wellness care may help most.

Our veterinary research team estimates Dolly may benefit from preventative weight management support — metabolic and activity biology suggests proactive weight management may improve long-term mobility. This does NOT mean Dolly will develop illness; it highlights areas where long-term wellness care may help most.
